Anthropic's Revenue Surges as IPO Speculation Builds
videos.description: Anthropic is telling prospective investors its second-quarter revenue jumped at least 14-fold versus the same period a year ago, according to documents seen by Bloomberg News. This comes as speculation builds around a potential IPO. Bloomberg's Rachel Metz breaks down the latest financial figures and how they compare with OpenAI's growth. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech."
